Network Security

爆炸半径缩减

Limiting the potential impact of a security breach by isolating assets and implementing controls that constrain the effects of an incident. See NIST SP 800-207 (Zero Trust) and CIS Controls.

Definition

Limiting the potential impact of a security breach by isolating assets and implementing controls that constrain the effects of an incident. See NIST SP 800-207 (Zero Trust) and CIS Controls.

Operational example
